response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98;

assumptions.assumption: Higher-value means strictly above 3.98. AVG ignores NULL totals and returns NULL if no invoices qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so invoices totaling exactly 3.98 qualify.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98;

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so invoices totaling exactly 3.98 qualify.
